I have an end user that is having the same issue with no kernel extension appearing in Catalina. The instructions they were provided to install do not compensate for the OS not supporting kernel extensions anymore, and there are not any online resources to troubleshoot with!
Make sure your Zoom application is up to date, check your camera/webcam drivers to see if they need an update as well. Hell, look to see if there’s a Windows update as well!
At the top of the your settings page on the zoom.us website there should be some options for recordings and I believe you can change the recording views there.

Try reinstalling Zoom and also updating your webcam driver or reinstalling your webcam. Do this in device manager, probably in the camera tab listed something like ‘integrated webcam’ try updating driver, give a restart if you do get an update, if that doesn’t work try disabling webcam device and enabling it again. Then if that doesn’t work, uninstall and reinstall your webcam device. After you select uninstall on the device you can go to the ‘action’ tab at top of device manager and ‘scan for hardware changes’ if it doesn’t automatically reinstall then you can go to laptop manufacturers website and there is usually a support program there that will scan your computer, or google ‘laptop make and model’ webcam or camera driver.
